CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2712 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 7afd9452b7ac703bfa9f6ef88033120189d39d4b. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 7afd9452b7ac703bfa9f6ef88033120189d39d4b for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-demand-overbook-r5, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-demand-overbook-r5 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-demand-overbook-r5; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from handoff/r10-demand-overbook-r4 (tip 1193fd228, the code of PR #2712, head 7afd9452b7ac703bfa9f6ef88033120189d39d4b); do not restart from main. Merge origin/main first.
Round 4 verdict blocked (git show origin/review/2712:VERDICT.md; read it whole). By fixer.md this is the FOURTH block: you RE-CUT the body minimal (only figures re-taken in this pass, each with its command), you do not repair it.
(1) structure-breach: `python3 tests/structure.py` at the merge with main prints `FAIL seam_cut_total 424 > 418 (+6)`; main is 420 (under #2711's definition the diff adds +4: the new `_track_dhw` helper and its crossings). Pay the +6 by improving the code (move, delete, share or refactor; tools/audit/archscore/ run before and after must not read worse and judgement must find it sounder; gaming the score pays nothing). Only if no architecture-improving payment exists, raise as a last resort under the standing mandate (CLAUDE.md rule 2) with `## Raise justification` listing each payment tried and its `Architecture score: dS` line.
(2) carry-missing: the body's Carry markers do not match the roster (read origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, tip 71d2bb6c2 or later): `Carry: R10-COP-PARTLOAD` (optimality item) and `Carry: R10-HEAT-METER` (dhw_temp_trajectory item) point to groups that hold 0 carries from this group; both items sit in R10-BUFFER-STORE: point each Carry at the group that really holds it, or `Carry: dismissed: <reason>`. Both `## Friction` items (R10-FIXER-DISPATCH-REF, R10-HARNESS-COPY-NAME) carry to R10-ORCH-MACHINERY, which is stage `absorbed` (a dead destination): route them to a LIVE group (carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/main shows live ones) or dismiss with a reason. Round 3's R10-PREPR-UNPINNED-RED friction item is gone from the body: route it to a live group. Cite the roster SHA. A carry to a group that lacks the text needs the roster seat (SEAT-OWED to main); do not claim a carry the roster does not hold.
(3) Stale figures: the head prints `ALL 4369 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED`, not 4367; `## Head` and the claim "STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED / Nothing is raised" must be true at the new head. The `killed_by` reason on running_kw.CMP_BOUND.5f36889b says `rc=1 failed=2`; the mutant fails 1 check: correct the reason.
Push handoff/r10-demand-overbook-r5 (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-demand-overbook-r5.
